notes: Assessment evidence only. Class/subclass records cover level one, not whole-class progression. Spell entries include their printed scaling but no higher-level implementation is proposed. Complete spell-list coverage and general casting, concentration, healing and targeting rules require separate review. No runtime support attested.

source.section: Cleric: level-one table row, class features, Spellcasting, Divine Domain

facts.proficiencies: Light/medium armor, shields, simple weapons; WIS/CHA saves; two skills from History, Insight, Medicine, Persuasion, Religion.
facts.equipment: Mace or proficient warhammer; scale/leather or proficient chain mail; light crossbow plus 20 bolts or simple weapon; priest/explorer pack; shield and holy symbol; background equipment additional.
facts.casting: Three cantrips; two level-one slots. Prepare max(1, WIS modifier + cleric level) class-list spells of available slot levels. Casting preserves preparation; long rest restores slots and permits changing preparation, requiring prayer of one minute per spell level.
facts.ability: WIS; save DC 8 + proficiency + WIS modifier; attack proficiency + WIS modifier.
facts.ritual: Requires a prepared cleric spell with ritual tag; holy symbol can serve as focus.
facts.domain: Chosen at level one; domain spells always prepared, outside preparation count; off-list domain spells are cleric spells.

source.section: Life Domain: level-one spell row, Bonus Proficiency, Disciple of Life

facts.grants: Heavy armor proficiency; Bless and Cure Wounds.
facts.healing: Disciple of Life adds 2 + spell level when a leveled spell restores a creature's HP.

source.section: Entire spell entry before Comments; page 272

facts.resolution: Dexterity save; failure deals 1d8 radiant damage; success avoids it. Cover gives no benefit on this save.

source.section: Entire spell entry before Comments; page 230

facts.resolution: Touched creature recovers 1d8 + casting ability modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.
facts.scaling: Each slot level above first adds 1d8.

source.section: Entire spell entry including material footnote before Comments; page 219

facts.resolution: Choose up to three creatures in range. Each may add a rolled d4 to its attack rolls and saving throws while the spell lasts.
facts.scaling: Each slot level above first permits one extra target.
